content:
olivia: spinning up the new AZ-pair in ap-southeast-edge-1 today. need to finalise terraform/pulumi flow and handoff notes.
raj: ok — what's the plan for remote state? s3 or gcs?
maria: prefer S3 with state-lock in dynamodb for now, aligns with existing regions. will add lifecycle rules.
kevin: +1 S3. also we need a separate bucket prefix: rw-inference/edge/ap-se-1/terraform-state. add encryption and restricted kms.
olivia: noted. raj, can you patch module to accept backend config via env + CI secrets? want to keep module idempotent across pulumi/terraform bridge.
raj: working on a small refactor — adding backend.tfvars support. will also export a remote-state module so pulumi can call out to it.
maria: think about locking semantics: terraform uses dynamodb, pulumi will use an explicit S3 state with partial locks via leader election (we documented this last quarter). add a step in runbook to manually unlock if a pipeline fails.
kevin: quota heads up — A100s not available in the new AZ by default. you'll need quota increase request ticket. I already opened one: Q-4932. ETA 48h.
olivia: thanks. if quota delayed, fallback plan is to route capacity to nearest region and mark region as limited in the routing policy. include fallback in rollout playbook.
ci-bot: deploy-pipeline triggered: refs/heads/edge/standup -> infra-edge-deploy. status: queued.
raj: local patch for module (WIP):
```hcl
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/internal/terraform-modules.git//vpc?ref=edge-standup"
  name   = "ap-se-edge-1"
  azs    = ["ap-se-edge-1a","ap-se-edge-1b"]
}
```
maria: validation checklist draft:
- verify tags + billing codes (team:inference, env:prod-edge)
- VPC RFC: subnets + route tables per AZ with NAT pools
- BGP session test between edge and transit-gw
- SG rules locked down to infra CIDRs only
- GPU instance boot smoke: run nvidia-smi and small perf-run
- remote-state accessible and locked
- prometheus metrics exported to central prometheus cluster
- cost estimate <= $X/day for baseline traffic

kevin: add to checklist: test preemptible eviction behaviour and autoscaler drain hooks. cost delta if we use spot vs reserved.
olivia: handoff section for oncall: include runbooks for: 1) state unlock 2) pipeline rollback 3) emergency detach of route table 4) reassigning capacity to fallback region. keep short commands.
raj: added unlock snippet to runbook:
```bash
# unlock terraform state
aws dynamodb delete-item --table-name rw-tf-state-locks --key '{"LockID":{"S":"ap-se-edge-1"}}'
```
maria: and pulumi unlock note: run pulumi cancel on the CI runner, then remove the lock object from S3 if needed.
sre-ops: network gotcha: cloud provider advertises only /24s for edge-cidr pool, need to ensure we don't accidentally create overlapping /22s. put a validation lint into the module.
olivia: good catch. raj can we add a pre-apply validation hook that checks cidr ranges against an allowed list?
raj: yes, will add a `validate_cidr` helper and add a CI gate that fails fast.
ci-bot: infra-edge-deploy job failed on plan: resource_quota_exceeded -> gpu quota.
kevin: that's the ticket showing up. we can re-run plan after quota confirmed.
maria: for handoff, I'll write a short Slack template for support to post into #support when they start seeing capacity errors (include links to ticket & runbook).
olivia: timeline: aim for soft launch tomorrow with capacity pinned to 0.5 node pool, smoke tests only. full traffic once quota & monitoring green.
raj: pushing branch now: refs/heads/edge/standup -> please review @maria @kevin. I'll add changelog and notes for terraform -> pulumi state mapping.
kevin: quick cost estimate in the PR: baseline daily ~ $420, spikes with real traffic ~ $1200. adding autoscaler policies should keep avg closer to baseline.
maria: final acceptance criteria for handoff: all checks passing in CI, metrics shipping for 24h in staging, oncall runbook ack by SRE.
olivia: perfect. I'll create the formal handoff ticket and assign to @sre-ops. thanks everyone :rocket:
